name: Al Afuww
description: Allah pardons by erasing sins. Al Ghafoor emphasises forgiveness and concealment of sins; Al Afuww emphasises their removal.
summary: Al Afuww expresses pardon and the effacing of sins. It overlaps with forgiveness, while drawing attention to removal of the offence rather than retaining it against a person. Quran 4:149 connects Allah's pardon with His power.
